# Page-local reuse with global numbering

This website keeps reusable-footnote identity local to each rendered HTML page, but the visible footnote numbers continue across the project.

José Afonso da Silva is cited here for the first time.^[See [@silva2026]{.bibentry}]

The same source is cited again on this page, so the second call reuses footnote **1** rather than creating another note.^[See [@silva2026]{.bibentry}]

The Constitution is a different source and receives footnote **2**.^[See [@brasil1988]{.bibentry}]

Continue to the [Doctrine](doctrine.qmd) page. Because this page contributed two canonical footnotes, the next page starts at **3**.
